title: Word-by-Word Story · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Word-by-Word Story · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a simple topic. The pair alternates one word at a time to make a complete sentence about the topic. The sentence is understandable and contains at least six words. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Word-by-Word Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The sentence is understandable and contains at least six words.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The sentence is understandable and contains at least six words.
